capabilities: Show a unified outline panel for Markdown and PDF files
Build outlines from Markdown headings and PDF bookmarks or table of contents
Jump to headings or PDF pages with deep links and offsets
Search, expand and collapse outline items per file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Unlike Obsidian’s built-in Outline (Markdown-only) or the default PDF outline view, this plugin automatically adapts to the active file
motivation: The author found that switching between the built-in Markdown outline and the separate PDF outline breaks flow while reading and navigating.
problem: Obsidian's core Outline only covers Markdown and PDFs have a separate outline view, so switching file types requires different panels and extra clicks.
summary: Single outline panel that adapts to the active file, showing Markdown heading outlines and PDF bookmark/TOC outlines in one place.
